verdict.rationale: Open WebUI is documented as a self-hosted platform that runs anywhere (Docker, Kubernetes, pip, bare metal), entirely offline, and even air-gapped. The operator therefore decides where the instance, and so the data, physically lives. However, the evidence never explicitly addresses data storage location, region selection, or residency controls; residency is only implied by the self-hosted deployment model. missing for 10: explicit data-storage/residency documentation (e.g. configurable database/file storage location), any region-selection guidance, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Open WebUI runs anywhere (Docker, Kubernetes, pip, bare metal)
self-hosted AI platform that's extensible, feature-rich, user-friendly, and built to run entirely offline
Air-Gapped: Complete network isolation for environments with the strictest security requirements.
